requests.name: game_create_session
requests.decisionNote: Create a production Player session; no seed, fixture or dev option.

requests.name: game_observe
requests.decisionNote: Read only legal current observation before selecting any action.

requests.name: game_execute_action
requests.decisionNote: The visible door is sealed. Scan is available and costs energy; discover lawful target/connection evidence.

requests.name: game_execute_action
requests.decisionNote: Correct the rejected request using the public ActionPayloadV1 wire schema; retry scan. No world state was read.

requests.name: game_observe
requests.decisionNote: Inspect the actual Scan evidence before identifying a jam target.

requests.name: game_execute_action
requests.decisionNote: Scan revealed a source-to-door seal link. Test ordinary interaction to confirm whether the receiver is currently blocked.

requests.name: game_execute_action
requests.decisionNote: Ordinary interaction was rejected by the active seal link with zero cost. Jam the discovered receiver, then test a short eastward movement.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: Probe east for one second using legal movement after successful Jam; observe the resulting position instead of assuming a map route.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: The eastward probe moved without collision and the door is passable with 299 Jam ticks left. Continue east for a bounded 90 ticks, then reassess the room and completion state.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: The new room has an inactive relay, unavailable bridge and a live Guard. Scan before choosing between suppression, combat, or environmental control.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: The Guard is discovered, its link is disconnected, and shoot_guard is available. Choose the implemented direct-clearing option while Jam is cooling down, without claiming generic fire combat exists.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: The first legal shot reduced Guard HP to 12 and is now cooling down. Probe a short eastward movement while its disconnected link keeps pressure low; reassess relay reachability.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: shoot_guard is available again and Guard HP is 12. Clear it with one legal shot while advancing another short eastward probe toward the discovered relay.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: Guard HP is now zero. Relay interaction is still out of reach, so continue a shorter eastward probe without enabling an unknown hazard.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: The relay is now legally reachable, Guard is cleared, and Scan evidence names the relay-to-bridge relation. Enable the relay and inspect the actual bridge response before crossing.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: Relay became ACTIVE and bridge is TRANSITIONING, not yet passable. The public bridge timer is 89 ticks, so wait exactly that budget rather than entering an unavailable bridge.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: The observed bridge is now STABLE and passable, with the Guard cleared. Continue the established eastward path for a bounded second and inspect for collision or crossing.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: Position advanced across the stable span without damage, but crossed/completed remain false. Continue east another bounded 60 ticks while preserving the active relay.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: Still alive at the farther east position with a stable bridge, but no completion event yet. Use a shorter 45-tick eastward probe to find the safe crossing endpoint.

requests.name: game_step
requests.decisionNote: Far-east ground is reachable and another control is in range, but completion is still false. Do not toggle the relay and risk the bridge; explore a short perpendicular northward segment for the safe endpoint.

requests.name: game_get_events
requests.decisionNote: The public observation reports completed and crossed at tick 501. Collect the legal ordered event trace for replay evidence before closing the production session.

requests.name: game_close_session
requests.decisionNote: Completion and all 29 ordered public events have been recorded; close the Player session and release resources.
